build_BEiT_backbone: build a BEiT vision transformer backbone with configurable embed_dims, num_layers, and num_heads for semantic segmentation
create_BEiTAttention_module: create a BEiTAttention module with window-based multi-head self-attention and relative position bias for a given window size
create_BEiTTransformerEncoderLayer: create a BEiTTransformerEncoderLayer with learnable scaling gamma parameters and DropPath stochastic depth
resize_rel_pos_embed: resize relative position embedding weights from a pre-trained checkpoint to match a different patch shape using geometric interpolation
init_weights_BEiT: initialize BEiT model weights using trunc_normal or load from a pre-trained checkpoint with relative position bias interpolation
